decisions: D1 tick rounding (ticks_exact == false) stays a receipt flag, not an export refusal (brief decision 4); the 100 ns test in foundation_contract stays green
D2 require_exact_start takes `nearest` as a closure evaluated only on a refusal, so Preview and exact exports do no extra work and see no new error (the brief's signature took a Ticks value)

D3 guard placement keeps existing error precedence: after OutOfRange in isobmff (track.seek), wav (declared length) and mxf (end > total); wav/pcm/y4m/mxf guards precede every payload read; Truncated/OutOfRange for an unaligned export request are therefore reported as before when they apply first

D4 test builders: instead of adding fiel/clap fields to Mp4Spec (9 struct-literal sites would have been edited) tests/common gained mp4_bytes_with_children + visual_child (raw child bytes, so truncated and lying children are writable); no existing test edited except video_route.rs (+Plan::DropPicture, +1 test) and v4_hardening.rs (+ zero-length entry assertions inside the existing aggregate test)
D5 FieldInfo/CleanAperture follow the brief: clap fields are the eight signed 32-bit values of the Apple clean aperture atom (page re-read 2026-10-11: all eight SInt32)
